listeners.why: Restfox's main process tells the window a file workspace changed on disk (workspaceChanged) and pushes the events of a gRPC call (onGrpcEvent). This port has no file workspaces, no second process and no gRPC engine, so it records each callback and never fires it.

noop.why: Setters for state this port does not keep. updateElectronApp: the build updates through Orivon, and Restfox's own updater is Electron's. setDisableSSLVerification: a routed request carries no TLS option, so there is nothing to switch; sendRequest says so when a certificate is refused.

getInstallInfo.why: Main answers which package the app was installed from (snap, deb, portable). This build has no package. 'other' is the value main gives an install it does not recognise; it is read only by the page-view ping, which this port leaves as upstream wrote it.

openFolder.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
openFolder.why: Opens a host path in the operating system's file manager, which a page cannot do. Reached only from the file workspace menu, which needs a file workspace to exist.

readFile.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
readFile.why: Reads a path relative to a file workspace's folder for the readFile() a request script calls. Without a file workspace there is no folder to read from. A script that calls it gets this error inside its own sandbox.

getWorkspaceAtLocation.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
getWorkspaceAtLocation.why: Reads a folder's workspace.json from a host path. Part of the file workspace set, which needs the folder picker above.

updateWorkspace.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
updateWorkspace.why: Writes a file workspace's metadata to its folder. Restfox calls it only for a workspace of type file, and none can be created here.

ensureEmptyFolderOrEmptyWorkspace.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
ensureEmptyFolderOrEmptyWorkspace.why: Checks a chosen folder before a file workspace is created in it.

getCollectionForWorkspace.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
getCollectionForWorkspace.why: Restfox's db.ts calls it only when the workspace's _type is file; every other workspace lives in IndexedDB, which the page owns.

getCollectionById.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
getCollectionById.why: Same gate as getCollectionForWorkspace: file workspaces only.

grpcLoadSchema.detail: gRPC calls are not available in this build: they need an HTTP/2 client, which a page does not have
grpcLoadSchema.why: Lists a server's methods, by reflection or from .proto files, with @grpc/grpc-js in main. Restfox awaits it and shows the rejection as the reason the methods could not be loaded.

grpcCancelSchemaLoad.detail: gRPC calls are not available in this build: they need an HTTP/2 client, which a page does not have
grpcCancelSchemaLoad.why: Stops a schema load by its id. Restfox calls it when the user cancels a load, which never starts here.

grpcConvertInsomniaMessage.detail: gRPC calls are not available in this build: they need an HTTP/2 client, which a page does not have
grpcConvertInsomniaMessage.why: Rewrites an imported Insomnia gRPC message into ProtoJSON from the request's .proto files. Restfox's importer catches the rejection and keeps the message as Insomnia wrote it.

grpcStartCall.detail: gRPC calls are not available in this build: they need an HTTP/2 client, which a page does not have
grpcStartCall.why: Opens a gRPC call and pushes its events through onGrpcEvent. Restfox turns the rejection into the call's error event, which the response panel prints.

grpcSendMessage.detail: gRPC calls are not available in this build: they need an HTTP/2 client, which a page does not have
grpcSendMessage.why: Sends a message on an open client or bidirectional stream. A call never opens, so none is sent.

grpcEndCall.detail: gRPC calls are not available in this build: they need an HTTP/2 client, which a page does not have
grpcEndCall.why: Ends the client side of a stream. A call never opens, so none ends.

grpcCancelCall.detail: gRPC calls are not available in this build: they need an HTTP/2 client, which a page does not have
grpcCancelCall.why: Cancels an open call. A call never opens, so none is cancelled.
